title: [2.8.2.14-dev] Bolus nowhere to be found
body:
**AndroidAPS 2.8.2.14-dev** 
**Build**: 8783e67a9
**Flavor**: Fullrelease

**Problem description**:
I did a manual Bolus at around (maybe between) 09:25 & 09:50, then I noticed that my pod is ticking a lot due to SMBs, I checked AAPS, found that my BG is rising fast & the bolus is nowhere to be found, no trace at all.

**Log files:**
[AndroidAPS._2021-12-06_00-00-01_.2.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7660212/AndroidAPS._2021-12-06_00-00-01_.2.zip)
